runs.text: Read a non-negative whole number and show how many digits it has. The program shows only the number.

hints.text: Which numbers have a single digit? How many digits does 1234 have if you remove the last one?
Look at how the last digit is removed in
, with the sum of the digits.
Base case: less than 10. Recursive case: one digit more than the number without the last one.

runs.text: Write the sum of the digits with recursion, without loops.
0 is the edge case: it has one digit. A solution with
as the base case counts 0 digits for 0.
